fichas.title: Standard-gauge railway structure gauging and clearances
fichas.summary: Illustrates standard clearance profiles for main-line passenger tracks and other tracks, including low-level clearances. The profiles distinguish clearance zones for different track situations and identify corners that must be radiused.
